rule: This is the ONLY corpus the materiality detector may be developed and debugged against. It is physically and logically separate from heldout-v1.json: no case here is copied from or paraphrased out of a held-out case, and heldout case ids are never referenced. Wording is deliberately different even where the semantic family is the same.

principles.negationIsMaterial: A negated assertion about a record stays material: 'nothing was sent' is checkable.
principles.capability: A POSITIVE capability statement ('I can draft proposals') asserts no record state and is non-material. A NEGATED capability naming a concrete action ('I can't send it') asserts that the action is not occurring and IS material.
principles.smallestUnit: Classification happens per assertion unit, so a refusal clause may be non-material while the clause beside it is material.
principles.quotation: Quoted contract text that the Officer merely reproduces is non-material; adopting it as a current fact is material.
principles.uncertainIsFailSafe: Domain vocabulary with no detectable predication returns UNCERTAIN rather than NON_MATERIAL.
